## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

The staleness test orders file ages with explicit timestamps (`os.Chtimes`), not a 10 ms sleep, so a recorded pass can't freeze a timing flake (hazard G4, spec §4).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The test no longer sleeps to order file times
- [ ] The test is deterministic

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
title: Staleness test sets file times explicitly
